readout_other: Morris water maze; elevated plus maze; Western blot, ChIP, qPCR and ELISA for BDNF, histone acetylation, HDAC; MDA, SOD, GSH, GSH-Px assays
direction_notes: LIPUS reversed AlCl3-induced cognitive deficits, restored H3K9/H4K12 acetylation and BDNF and raised antioxidant enzyme activity; neuronal excitation or inhibition was not assessed.

target.label: 3.0 mm posterior and 2.5 mm lateral region of the bregma

timing.protocol_description: 1 Hz, 5% duty cycle, 50 ms burst lengths; three sonications of 5 min with 5 min intervals, daily for 42 days (LIPUS-plus-AlCl3 rats started 7 days before AlCl3), under isoflurane.

source_quotes.n_subjects: (Results were shown as mean s.d., n 10 per group
